messages:
Kelly (Support): FYI escalating Brightloop trial brightloop-7 — embed requests timing out during a large docs ingest. They have a product demo tomorrow and said it will pause if not fixed. @Arjun can CS own? :rotating_light:
Arjun (CSM): On it. Kelly, paste console error + any SDK flags they changed.
Kelly (Support): Console shows quota_exceeded spikes. Snippet:

```
2026-05-05T16:03:12Z ERROR embed-service tenant=brightloop-7 rate=790/s limit=450/s quota_exceeded
2026-05-05T16:03:14Z ERROR client sdk timeout req=lkj321
```

Kelly (Support): They said they switched "concurrency=10" in SDK yesterday while ramping ingestion.
Marta (CS): Risk: stalled onboarding -> missed demos -> renewal pressure. Proposed plan: 1) immediate ack+ETA, 2) 30m triage with eng within 4h, 3) temporary uplift + smoothing for demo window, 4) enablement on batching. I can handle external comms.
Ravi (Engineer): Likely burst above their tenant credit and embed fleet in us-east-1 at high util. Short-term: bump soft limit to 1000/s for 12-24h and enable smoothing. Long-term: client batching, SDK default tweaks, autoscale. I'll join call.
Arjun (CSM): Draft short note to customer: "Hi Brightloop 1 — thanks for flagging. We're investigating throttling during your recent ingest that's affecting demos. We've scheduled a quick troubleshooting call with engineers and will temporarily increase throughput while we stabilize. We'll also run a short enablement session on batching best-practices. Meeting invite coming.  Arjun, CSM"
Kelly (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, please uplift ASAP, demo at 10:00."
Ravi (Engineer): I'll prepare the uplift command and monitoring queries. Will only execute after verbal OK on the call and will post rollback plan here.
ops-bot: [meeting] Created incident-brightloop-1769999990 at 2026-05-05T18:30:00Z; attendees: Arjun, Ravi, Kelly, Marta
Marta (CS): Action items: Marta send ack (done); Ravi prep uplift + dashboard; Kelly collect SDK flags + request traces; Arjun prep enablement slides.
Arjun (CSM): Note to team: keep customer comms simple and avoid infra jargon. We'll escalate renewal to RevOps only if mitigation >24h.
Kelly (Support): -- end thread --
